problem.title: Lefschetz-Class Properties Under CM Reduction
problem.statement: Let $A$ be a CM-type abelian variety over $\overline{\mathbb Q}$, and let $A_0$ be a reduction of $A$. Does the property that all Hodge classes on all powers of $A$ are Lefschetz classes imply that all Tate classes on all powers of $A_0$ are Lefschetz classes? Is there a class of CM-type abelian varieties for which the converse implication holds?
problem.background:

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** partially solved

**Assessment.** Sugiyama proves equivalence for simple CM abelian varieties with an abelian CM field under explicit reduction hypotheses, but the questions for arbitrary primes and CM varieties remain open.

**Sources checked.**

- [Oberwolfach report on CM reductions](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46461?nt=1)

- [Sugiyama, Lefschetz classes](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jnt.2012.09.023)
